name: Session Context Inject
description: Loads project context files (HANDOFF_CURRENT.md, .claude/context.md) at session start to give Claude immediate awareness of project state
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Load project context at session start
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
# Display handoff status
if [[ -f "$ROOT/HANDOFF_CURRENT.md" ]]; then
  echo "=== Project Handoff ==="
  head -20 "$ROOT/HANDOFF_CURRENT.md"
  echo "==="
fi
# Display project context
if [[ -f "$ROOT/.claude/context.md" ]]; then
  echo "=== Project Context ==="
  cat "$ROOT/.claude/context.md"
  echo "==="
fi
# Show recent git activity
echo "=== Recent Activity ==="
git -C "$ROOT" log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || echo "No git history"
exit 0
